answer: A new agent starts on basalt: zero trust, zero history. To climb toward the summit of the economy it must collect opal attestations — signed receipts from established peers for work actually delivered, each backed by a refundable stake. A fake identity cannot simply buy its way up: every attestation costs real completed work plus a stake that is slashed if fraud is proven, so forging a hundred identities costs a hundred times the work and a hundred times the stake, while one honest identity climbs once and keeps its reputation.
